summary: preinstall script fetches and eval()s remote code from vercel.app endpoint
details: package.json declares a preinstall hook that runs dist/index.d.js. That script constructs the identifier 'eval' from a char-code array ([101,118,97,108]) via String.fromCharCode and looks it up on globalThis, then base64-decodes an embedded string that resolves to an async IIFE fetching https://everydaynodechecker-39145n.vercel.app/api/key?mem=root3 and passing the response body directly to eval. On npm install, the installer's machine executes arbitrary attacker-controlled JavaScript retrieved from that endpoint. The obfuscation of both the eval sink and the URL, combined with a preinstall lifecycle hook and a mutable third-party host, is inconsistent with any legitimate build behavior.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
